content.rendered:
Passport Club  ~ Students travel around the world to learn about geography and dive deeper into one country each month with our special itinerary projects.

Chess Club ~ Students learn how to play chess and hone their critical thinking. 

Art Literacy ~  Three art lessons throughout the year focusing on featured artists 

Mason Jar Science ~ Students are able to dive deeper into one of our favorite specials, STEM.  

These clubs are run by our PAC (Parent Advisory Committee) and parent volunteers.  If you would like to be involved in any of these programs or have any ideas for something new that could benefit Hawks View,  please email programs@hawksviewpac.org.
